a.xlink:title: make_build: reads IDENTITY and DIST_DIR from the make command line; writes nothing; runs build.sh with them
a.text: [build] build, sign and embed evidence into …/PolicyWitness.app

a.xlink:title: admission: reads BUILD_XPC, PW_INSPECTION and the argument list; --help prints the usage and exits before any check, after the knobs are validated; writes nothing
check_limits: reads docs/limits.json and the documents it renders; writes nothing
check_contract: reads docs/contract.json, docs/architecture.json and their generated copies; writes nothing
check_build_doc: reads docs/build.json, build.sh, meson.build, the Makefile, the inventories, the baseline and the generated copies; writes nothing
check_identity: reads the identity inputs and the three generated copies; writes nothing
stamp: reads git describe, rev-parse and rev-list, or PW_VERSION and PW_BUILD_NUMBER from the environment; writes the four stamp variables for Cargo and the plists
minimum: reads LSMinimumSystemVersion in Info.plist; writes MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET for Cargo
sdk: reads the SDK path xcrun reports under DEVELOPER_DIR; writes SDKROOT for Cargo and Meson
builddir: reads builddir/meson-info/meson-info.json when the directory is configured; writes nothing
identity: reads IDENTITY and the keychain listing; the two knobs, for Meson's options and RUSTFLAGS; writes RUSTFLAGS, when inspection is on and it was unset or empty

cargo: reads cargo on PATH with its configuration, caches and registries; controller/ sources, the stamp variables, MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET, SDKROOT and RUSTFLAGS; the artifact paths Cargo reports; writes controller/target/release/ under the pinned output directory, and the messages file Cargo reports its artifacts in
toolchain: reads meson and ninja on PATH and ninja's version; writes nothing
a.text: Checking the native toolchain (meson, ninja … or newer)

a.xlink:title: configure: reads whether builddir/build.ninja exists, meson.build, meson.options and the two knobs as Meson options; a fresh setup also reads CFLAGS and the other flag variables; writes builddir/ configuration; meson configure records the two options and the policy assertions run at setup or at the regeneration the next compile triggers
a.text: Configuring native build (meson configure, existing directory): …

a.xlink:title: compile: reads the native sources through builddir/; a changed option triggers regeneration, which runs the policy assertions first; writes builddir/ outputs and the Swift module cache under it
native_check: reads Meson's introspection of builddir/, Ninja's dependency log, the identity inputs and the Meson outputs' load commands; writes nothing
a.text: Checking the configured native source lists and the identity closure against the tree

a.xlink:title: assemble: reads Info.plist, the three Rust outputs, runner/augments/, dist/README.md and dist/AGENTS.md; writes the two documents under DIST_DIR; removes the previous app, ZIP and guide; the stamped Info.plist, the three Rust executables and the augments under the new app
embed_client: reads builddir/pw-runner-client; writes Contents/MacOS/pw-runner-client and its dSYM in inspection builds
skip_xpc: reads nothing; writes nothing

embed_services: reads each service's Info.plist and builddir/ host, the worker and the validator; writes each service bundle: its stamped Info.plist, the host with its dSYM in inspection builds, the worker and the validator
presign: reads the identity inputs and copies, and whether PolicyWitness.entitlements exists; writes nothing
a.text: Checking host/worker identity again, before signing

a.xlink:title: sign_tools: reads the copied top-level helpers; writes signatures on the top-level helpers
sign_services: reads each service's Entitlements.plist and bundle; writes signatures on the nested helpers, then each service seal
evidence: reads the signed bytes, entitlements and exported symbols of the helpers, services and augments; writes Contents/Resources/Evidence/manifest.json and symbols.json
seal: reads PolicyWitness.entitlements; writes the app seal over everything under Contents/
verify: reads the sealed app; writes nothing
signer: reads every regular file under the app's and each service's Contents/MacOS; writes nothing
sign_observer: reads controller/target/release/sandbox-log-observer; writes that executable's signature, in place
guide: reads docs/PolicyWitness.md and its inputs; writes PolicyWitness.md under DIST_DIR
zip: reads the sealed app; writes PolicyWitness.zip under DIST_DIR
